verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo (github.com/openai/codex) shows Codex CLI's source is publicly hosted and installable via npm, and a community comment implies CLI source can be inspected/diagnosed ('if you were using codex cli, you could have easily diagnosed and filed an issue'), while the same comment explicitly notes the Codex App is NOT open source. No explicit license file or license terms are cited anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: an explicit license declaration (e.g., MIT/Apache) for the CLI repo, confirmation of open-source status for other components (Codex Web, App, cloud), and independent corroboration of license terms.
